sentences.text: No: for a Tier 3 UCB, a floating-rate business loan to an MSE with sanctioned amount up to ₹50 lakh is covered by the 2025 UCB Directions, which say the bank shall not levy any pre-payment charges.
The loan facts match that rule because the case is a Tier 3 UCB, the purpose is business, the borrower is an MSE, the rate type is floating, and the sanctioned amount is ₹40 lakh.
The earlier RBI pre-payment-charge directions for floating-rate loans are no longer in force on the as-of date.
